Ben / Monica —

Thanks for the agenda. Two quick clarifications from our side after the call:

- Our infra team ran a latency sweep and prefers the fp16 quantized model for the pilot; that will reduce inference cost in production by ~18% per token in our testing. We will provide formal signoff by 11/04 17:00 PT.
- For rollback criteria: we need a clear metric-based gate. Propose: fail if error-rate > 3% or 95th p95 latency > 450ms for 15 min during rehearsal.
